meaning: Generate native pure typed boundary functions from checked Workflow bindings, preserving existing domain value and Event input semantics without orchestration or business-rule execution.
input_binding: One registered checked Workflow, the exact same registered exact field compilation, and these exact definition bytes. Reuse the existing structured value and expression specialization and Event scalar support; reject unregistered, stale or cross-graph inputs.
capture: Capture the complete declared Workflow input before any suspension or Operation call. Bound inert data with bigint is copied; ordinary values use selected exact structural normalization. Root parameters and Event inputs are required slots. Nested ordinary optionals normalize missing to null; Event optional payload fields preserve absence. Capture neither invokes getters/coercion nor retains mutable caller aliases.
events: Emit pure Event input normalizers with current occurrence, payload, signed integer, finite decimal, nonempty identity/reference/time and required/generated occurredAt shape rules. Generated-time input has no occurredAt and no clock. Do not create an Event, call a clock, infer a reference lookup or widen Event signed integers into UInt64.
results: captureResult takes the captured input instance, one exact step ID and a raw returned value. It produces an owned normalized result slot tied to that captured input and exact step/action. This establishes value shape and occurrence binding, not actual commit, nominal domain ownership or business invariants. R03 calls it only after R01 confirms committed metadata.
availability: Each forward argument function requires exactly its preceding source prefix of same-capture registered result slots. Compensation argument functions require an exact source prefix reaching their for_step and read only the statically checked scope; accepting a later completed prefix does not expose later values through new expressions. No duplicate, reordered, future, forged, cloned or cross-capture results.
expressions: Lower only already checked input, step-result, ontology-property, literal, payload-free variant and explicit to_set expressions. Preserve existing collection projection and Entity identity versus Value Object equality. No implicit unwrap, dereference, query, Calculation or Mapping call.
outputs: Emit typed captured inputs and result slots, fixed per-occurrence forward/compensation argument functions with exact Operation/action descriptors, and a final result function requiring every forward result. Copy/freeze outputs; source-bound descriptors and exact source hashes describe the generated artifact. Producing a typed final value is not Workflow execution or proof of commit.
recovery: Compensation argument materialization is separate from recovery eligibility, order, intent creation or execution. This unit does not mutate the existing expression-only Recovery Intent or choose which compensations run. R03 joins only a selected plan with these exact typed bindings and retains action/occurrence identity.
compatibility: Existing Workflow source/bindings, R01 outcome bridge, recovery policy, value/Operation/Event emitters and canonical definitions retain their bytes. No new language type, domain relationship or consumer default is selected.
not_claimed: commit truth or durable replay protection
